sentences.text: On 1.27, the documentation does not describe a way to add selectable fields to custom resources, only mentions that field selectors work on metadata fields and that custom resources can use field selectors if fields are declared in the CustomResourceDefinition’s `spec.versions[*].selectableFields` field (feature gated and enabled by default in 1.31).

citations.quote: Field selectors are essentially resource *filters*. By default, no selectors/filters are applied

sentences.text: On 1.31, selectable fields are added by listing them in the CustomResourceDefinition’s `spec.versions[*].selectableFields` field, which is enabled by default via the `CustomResourceFieldSelectors` feature gate.

citations.quote: Fields declared in a CustomResourceDefinition may also be used with field selectors when included in the `spec.versions[*].selectableFields` field of the CustomResourceDefinition
